title: east campus / trevor
notes: A lighthearted cotton-polyester blend to wear on a cool day. It's got a lot of spirit.

title: lumberjack fantasy / leah
notes: This makes me feel like that girl who's in every movie... The one who's edgy but, aww, she has a heart of gold!

title: reciprocal strength / heeya
notes: Now that I think about it, I give this jacket power in the same way that I gain power from it. Not many of my clothes do that.

title: playing pretend / lyndsay
notes: What's behind that door? Do I know what's behind it or am I pretending not to know?

title: extended play / cj
notes: A trustworthy cardigan. Perfect for seasoning your dinner.

title: coolest one / sarah
notes: Whenever I wear this, I feel like I'm the coolest one in the room. Everyone needs a denim jacket.

title: mother nature / liv
notes: I wear this dress all the time in the summer. It makes me feel like I'm connected with the earth.

title: parisian rave / jamie
notes: It was literally in this old warehouse in the middle of nowhere. Dude, I thought I was gonna get kidnapped.

title: target adventure / natalee
notes: I wear this when I'm going to hang out at Target with my friends. It's soft, it's comfortable, it's lightweight.

title: mom's closet / chen chen
notes: I think she used to wear it to go out. I'm imagining her just having fun with her friends.

title: pleasant surprise / victoria
notes: I bought this in Tokyo, actually. Whenever I wear it, I always run into someone I wasn't expecting to see.

title: garden picnic / multy
notes: I love twirling around in this. There's so much freedom.

title: before sunrise / nicholas
notes: It reminds me of cold mornings when I was waiting to get driven to school. When it was really early.

title: pool hours / mary helen
notes: This jacket makes me feel like an adult. I always think of my mom wearing it.

title: fond memories / shailen
notes: It makes me think of family, and the family I've made at Duke. I like the way it looks like a white sweater that got really dirty.

title: winter romance / suzanna
notes: This dress makes me want to fall in love... Oh, I must have had this for longer than I thought!

title: squirmin' around / jordan
notes: When I see this shirt, I get invigorated. My sister made it for me, but I never wear it.

title: fall day / mitra
notes: This is more of a fall than winter jacket to me. Although I did wear it to a Valentine's Day party.

title: powerful woman / sara
notes: I bought this today and I'm already wearing it out. It just makes me feel like I can do anything.

title: little demon / mihir
notes: I wear it to a party when I know I'm gonna have a good time. I like the fractal-like patterns.
